rules.name: vendor/bundle
rules.what: Gems Bundler installed inside this project instead of system-wide.
rules.comeback: bundle install puts them back exactly as the Gemfile.lock lists them.

rules.name: vendor
rules.what: Every PHP package this project depends on, installed by Composer.
rules.comeback: composer install rebuilds it from composer.lock.

rules.name: Composer cache
rules.what: PHP packages Composer has downloaded, shared across projects.
rules.comeback: Composer downloads packages again when an install needs them.

rules.name: NuGet packages
rules.what: Every NuGet package your .NET projects have restored, kept in one shared folder.
rules.comeback: dotnet restore downloads the packages a project needs again.

rules.name: bin and obj
rules.what: Compiled output and intermediate build files for this .NET project.
rules.comeback: dotnet build (or building in your IDE) recreates both folders.

rules.name: Pub cache
rules.what: Dart and Flutter packages downloaded by pub, shared across projects.
rules.comeback: dart pub get or flutter pub get downloads them again.

rules.name: build and .dart_tool
rules.what: Flutter's build output and Dart's generated tool files for this project.
rules.comeback: flutter build or flutter run recreates them, and flutter pub get restores .dart_tool.

rules.name: .terraform
rules.what: Providers and modules terraform init downloaded for this configuration. Your state file sits next to it, not in it.
